description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/sql-delete-forms: each DELETE ran on what the previous one left. Asks which DELETE spellings Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) accepts over Dm and One. Before every statement Dm and One are emptied and refilled with their fixture rows by SQL; after it RecordsAffected, Errors, the IDs left in Dm and the count of One are read. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
